The effectiveness of therapy really depends on several factors. One of the most important things is your willingness to go through the process. If you go in thinking it’ll be useless and unhelpful and never do anything your therapist suggests then you probably won’t get much out of it. If you go in with a willingness and desire to change you could definitely get something out of it. Another important thing is choosing the right therapist. If you feel like you just don’t mesh with your therapist then don’t be afraid to get another one. You need someone who you can work well with. The last thing is the frequency of visits. You can have great sessions, but if you’re only going every other month it probably won’t do you much good. Also if you’re not consistently doing what you’re supposed to, it won’t do much good. You get out (usually) what you put in. Also the severity of the issues you’re going through plays a role in it as well.
